narr: A weak boundary tapped into plenty of moisture and instability for showers and thunderstorms. Weak winds aloft caused slow moving storms, which led to instance of flooding and flash flooding.
ev: US-50 Arlington Boulevard was closed at Long Branch near VA-699 Prosperity Avenue. Water was flowing across the roadway.

The water level along the Accotink Creek at Strathmeade Springs rapidly rose above flood stage at 6:46 AM EST, cresting at 254.54 feet at 9:35 AM EST. The water level fell below flood stage at 11:48 AM EST. Woodburn Road and Prosperity Avenue were flooded by at least six inches of flowing water.
There was a water rescue at the Intersection of VA-677 Old Courthouse Road and Besley Road due to high water flowing out of a creek.

The water level along Difficult Run rapidly rose out of its banks above flood stage at 7:43 AM EST before cresting at 196.17 feet at 11:15 AM EST. The water level fell below flood stage at 7:35 PM EST. Leigh Mill Road was flooded.
There was up to 3 feet of standing water in the roadway near the intersection of Union Street and King Street.
Browns Mill Road at Beulah Road was closed due to water from Wolftrap Creek flowing over the road.
Lawyers Run Road was closed due to flooding from Difficult Run. Water was flowing across the road.
Lillards Ford Road was closed in multiple locations due to high water.
